title: dryopteris pseudocaenopteris
intro: Dryopteris pseudocaenopteris, commonly known as a type of fern, is a plant species that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asian cultures, due to its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris pseudocaenopteris are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
